scenes.desc: You carry the puck through the neutral zone with speed. One defender waits far ahead with a big gap, watching you.
You cross the offensive blue line with the puck as a defender bumps into you shoulder to shoulder.
A loose puck sits behind you near the corner. You are turning back hard toward it, the short way, with a defender closing.
A rebound sits in front of the net during a scramble. You are beside the crease in a low, loaded stance; defenders and the goalie are reacting.
An opponent carries the puck through the neutral zone toward you. You are the defender skating backward, managing the gap between you.
You just lost the puck at the offensive blue line. Their winger takes off the other way with it while you pivot to chase.
Your defenseman skates backward through the neutral zone with the puck on a regroup. All three forwards are ahead, swinging for a pass.
You sell a hard crossover step to the left. The defender leans that way, hips turning, as you prepare to cut back the other way.
You carry the puck through center ice. A forechecker closes on you while two teammates are open, one on each wing.
You shield the puck in the corner with your body between it and a defender who leans on your back reaching around.
You have the puck on the half-wall. One teammate's lane has a defender's stick lying across it; another teammate's lane is completely clear.
Your teammate skates fast toward the net. You have the puck wide, choosing where to aim the pass for them.
A pass slides along the wall toward you. Behind your shoulder, out of easy view, a checker is closing in fast.
You are alone in the slot with the puck and a clear look. The goalie is set in the middle; the far corner of the net is open.
Your defenseman winds up for a shot from the point. You are at the net front, in the goalie's sightline, with your stick blade on the ice.
Your teammate has the puck behind their net and every defender is turned watching them. The far post is unguarded.
A two-on-one rush: the puck carrier drives one wing, a teammate drives the other, and a single defender holds the middle between them.
A three-on-two rush. The middle attacker drives hard toward the net between the two defenders while the puck moves up the wing.
You approach the offensive blue line with the puck. The defender keeps backing away, leaving a big soft gap of open ice in front of you.
The defender stands you up with a tight gap right at the blue line. Your winger is flying wide with speed, and the ice behind the defender is open.
You reach the blue line with a defender on you while your center trails open in space behind the play.
You just passed to a teammate and their defender steps up on them. Open ice waits behind that committed defender for your burst.
Your teammate battles with the puck in the corner. You are open at a passing angle, and another teammate drives toward the net, pulling a defender along.
You attack one-on-one. The defender is between you and the net — you are reading how much gap they give and how balanced their feet are.
A low cycle: you carry along the wall with a defender chasing, while a teammate rotates in behind you to fill your spot.
You hold the puck high in the zone with lots of room. Every teammate is covered right now — the defense is set and waiting.
You are the last player back with the puck in your own zone. A forechecker charges at you while your winger waits on the wall.
You are the defender, skating a curved path that steers the puck carrier toward the boards, your stick on the ice in their lane.
The puck battle is in your corner. Your check waits near the net front, and you hold position between them and your net, watching both.
Two attackers cross paths in your zone, swapping sides, while you and a teammate cover them. The far side of the ice sits quiet and open.
A pass is about to come through your area to an attacker you can't reach. Your stick blade slides into the lane while you hold body position.
The carrier hides the puck on their far side along the wall. You stay on them with body position, waiting for the puck to show.
Your defenseman has the puck behind your net with a forechecker chasing from one side. Your winger waits on the wall and your center swings low in support.
You are the first forechecker, closing on their defenseman behind the net on a curved angle while your linemate covers the near wall.
The other team rushes toward your net. You backcheck through the middle of the ice, closing on the open attacker who drives the middle lane.
Your defenseman intercepts a pass in your zone and looks up. You stretch up the wall ahead of the play, giving them an instant outlet.
A loose puck sits in the neutral zone between you and an opponent who is slightly closer to it. The race is on.

svgScenes.desc: Gold attacks right to left. The navy defender blocks the pass to the middle teammate while the puck carrier has a clear lane to the net.
Gold attacks bottom to top. The puck carrier is near the left boards, the middle drive pulls coverage low, and the trailing gold forward is open high in the slot.
Gold attacks left to right. The navy defender is backed deep into the slot, leaving open ice for the puck carrier to carry forward.
Gold attacks bottom to top. The navy defender shades toward the gold left winger, leaving the gold right winger open with a clear path.
